registration_timing: after Gate 2 aggregate/per-example and paired outcomes, before any full-dev S02b selector-swap score

scores_known_at_registration.matched_200_row_pilot: MMR improved R1/R2 over Greedy; NSGA-II five-seed mean was below Greedy

question: With the S02b routes, pool, length contract and RRF salience fixed, does a full-dev selector-only swap to MMR improve over Greedy, and does NSGA-II add anything beyond the deterministic selectors?

execution.embedding_cache: execution-only; use each Gate 2 dataset cache after F-51 exact-equivalence audit
execution.candidate_parallelism: at most 2 concurrent candidates; do not map 16 model-bearing processes merely because 16 CPU workers are available
execution.resume: completed candidates immutable; failed/interrupted attempts preserved before retry

measurement.family: 2 datasets x 13 non-anchor candidates x 4 endpoints = 104 Holm endpoints
measurement.selection_opportunities: 31 prior proposed configs + 26 new non-anchor full-dev configs = 57 proposed search operations

selection_rule.mmr_winner: highest macro within dataset; exact tie chooses lambda 0.7, then TF-IDF similarity for lower cost
selection_rule.cross_dataset: prefer one shared selector if macro delta versus the dataset-specific winner is <=0.001 on both datasets; otherwise declare a pre-existing task-profile-specific selector policy, never a hidden dataset-name switch
selection_rule.nsga_followup: run five full-dev seeds only if the single frozen seed is within 0.002 macro of the best deterministic selector or wins any metric
selection_rule.promotion: no candidate can reach dev-test unless it beats the adversarial baseline under the later multiplicity-corrected paired gate

deletion_rules.nsga2: remain comparator only; if it misses the follow-up rule, do not spend five full-dev seeds and retain the existing negative 200-row stability evidence
deletion_rules.sbert_selector_similarity: drop from the proposed selector if neither dataset gains over matched TF-IDF similarity after correction
deletion_rules.mmr: do not assume the 200-row pilot generalizes; retain as main selector only with full-dev evidence
